morseTopic.header: Back, A–Z reference, title, solid 8px settled-letter bar and settled / 26
morseTopic.primary: Current path row only; no docked duplicate
morseTopic.modes: Key, Listen, Read, Free play; opaque tray above phone navigation, normal flow above path at 980px
morseTopic.placement: Skip ahead opens placement; Start enters the first lesson
morseTopic.history: Legacy Fluency hub entries normalize to the Morse topic

display.purpose: Topic titles on the Learn sheet. The largest type in the product.

page-title.purpose: H1 on every top-level view. No eyebrow label above it.

readout.purpose: The mono voice: counts, dates, positions, status words, track labels, kickers. Everything the instrument reports rather than says.

shadows.name: edge
shadows.purpose: No-op. The bevel is retired; the name is kept so existing shadow lists stay valid.

shadows.name: edge-under
shadows.purpose: No-op. The bevel is retired; the name is kept so existing shadow lists stay valid.

shadows.name: engrave
shadows.purpose: The 1px line that outlines a recessed field (inputs, progress tracks, an engaged filter chip), which otherwise reads by its darker fill.

shadows.name: press
shadows.purpose: A held control dropping a pixel with a neutral shadow inside it.

shadows.name: press-lit
shadows.purpose: The same press read on the solid action fill, which needs less black in it to look held.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Buttons, small raised controls and Home plates.

shadows.name: ambient-panel
shadows.purpose: Reserved for the flashcard, the one focused surface in a session. Corresponds to the shadow token.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: The completion moment and the sheet.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default duration for hover/focus/active feedback on buttons, chips, fields, nav.

motion.name: reduced-motion-floor
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses all animation/transition durations to near-zero.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action-coloured control per screen: Start, Save topic, Begin session. A solid Signal fill with Ink-on-Signal text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.86 0.16 95); background: oklch(0.86 0.16 95); color: oklch(0.22 0.04 95); font: 700 0.86rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 18%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.86 0.16 95); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action, same shape as primary, a solid Raised fill; hover moves one fill step up.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.55 0.014 255); background: oklch(0.345 0.014 255); color: oklch(0.97 0.004 255); font: 700 0.86rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.40 0.015 255); border-color: oklch(0.62 0.014 255); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.86 0.16 95); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Track/status filter. The active state reuses the same action-equals-current logic as buttons and nav.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 11px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.55 0.014 255); background: oklch(0.30 0.013 255); color: oklch(0.97 0.004 255); font: 700 0.76rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease, color 0.18s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: oklch(0.62 0.014 255); } .ds-chip-active, .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: oklch(0.86 0.16 95); border-color: oklch(0.86 0.16 95); color: oklch(0.22 0.04 95); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.86 0.16 95); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Search and form input. Recessed by a darker fill than the surrounding surfaces, plus a 1px line.
components.css: .ds-field { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.42 0.014 255); background: oklch(0.22 0.012 255); color: oklch(0.97 0.004 255); font: 400 0.86rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: oklch(0.68 0.012 255); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.86 0.16 95); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: oklch(0.86 0.16 95); }

components.name: Topic Row
components.description: A dense index row, deliberately not a card. A hairline divider signals affordance instead of shadow or lift.
components.css: .ds-topic-row { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.42 0.014 255); border-radius: 0; padding: 15px 24px 15px 2px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.97 0.004 255); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease, padding 0.18s ease; } .ds-topic-row:hover { background: oklch(0.30 0.013 255); padding-inline: 10px; } .ds-topic-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; } .ds-topic-title { margin: 0; font: 700 0.98rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-topic-scope { max-width: 68ch; font-size: 0.77rem; color: oklch(0.83 0.012 255); margin: 4px 0 10px; } .ds-meta-row { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-tag { font-size: 0.72rem; color: oklch(0.75 0.012 255); } .ds-tag + .ds-tag::before { content: '\00b7'; color: oklch(0.55 0.014 255); margin-right: 6px; } .ds-status-dot { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(0.80 0.10 170); margin-right: 5px; } .ds-topic-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.86 0.16 95); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Inset rounded navigation on mobile, attached left rail on desktop. The current destination is marked in the action colour with aria-current=page.
components.html: <button class="ds-nav-btn ds-nav-btn-active" aria-current="page" aria-label="Library"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" width="22" height="22"><path d="M4 5.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 3H20v16H6.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 4 21.5v-16Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7"/><path d="M4 18.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 16H20" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7"/></svg>Library</button>
components.css: .ds-nav-btn { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; min-height: 50px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.83 0.012 255); font: 700 0.66rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.18s ease, background 0.18s ease; } .ds-nav-btn:hover { color: oklch(0.97 0.004 255); } .ds-nav-btn-active, .ds-nav-btn[aria-current='page'] { color: oklch(0.86 0.16 95); background: oklch(0.345 0.014 255); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 oklch(0.86 0.16 95); } .ds-nav-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.86 0.16 95); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sheet Close Button
components.description: 44x44px dismiss control on modal sheets. Always carries an explicit aria-label naming what it closes.
components.html: <button class="ds-close-btn" aria-label="Close topic details"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" width="18" height="18"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-close-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid oklch(0.42 0.014 255); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.345 0.014 255); color: oklch(0.97 0.004 255); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-close-btn:hover { background: oklch(0.40 0.015 255); border-color: oklch(0.62 0.014 255); } .ds-close-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.86 0.16 95); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: oklch(0.86 0.16 95); }

components.name: Mode Tile
components.description: A Morse mode in the fixed tray above navigation. A solid mode fill with its own ink, one word, no subtitle, and it shows the stimulus: a letter (Key), a waveform (Listen), dits and dashes (Read) or your own text at a cursor (Free play).
components.css: .ds-mode-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; min-height: 56px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: oklch(0.80 0.14 150); color: oklch(0.22 0.04 150); font: 700 0.86rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mode-stimulus { font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-mode-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.86 0.16 95); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Path Spine
components.description: The Morse course as one straight vertical line, top to bottom. Done is the action colour; ahead is Line Strong. Lessons have round nodes; the current row is a raised plate with a solid Signal node and the one Start action.
components.html:
1. Lesson 1
  2. Lesson 2
components.css: .ds-path { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-path-row { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 10px 0 10px 4px; color: oklch(0.97 0.004 255); } .ds-path-row::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 13px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px; background: oklch(0.55 0.014 255); } .ds-path-done::before { background: oklch(0.86 0.16 95); } .ds-node { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.014 255); background: oklch(0.255 0.012 255); } .ds-path-done .ds-node { border-color: oklch(0.86 0.16 95); background: oklch(0.86 0.16 95); } .ds-path-current { padding: 14px; border-radius: 12px; background: oklch(0.345 0.014 255); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%); } .ds-path-current .ds-node { border-color: oklch(0.86 0.16 95); background: oklch(0.86 0.16 95); }

components.name: Path Milestone
components.description: A word check or the A-Z Test on the Morse path: a full-width plate that crosses the spine with a square node (a flag for a word check, A-Z for the Test) and an uppercase label. Shape, width and label carry "this is a test".
components.css: .ds-milestone { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.42 0.014 255); border-radius: 12px; background: oklch(0.30 0.013 255); color: oklch(0.97 0.004 255); } .ds-milestone-node { display: grid; place-items: center; min-width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(0.255 0.012 255); border: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.014 255); font: 700 0.75rem ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-milestone-label { font: 700 0.86rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.055em; }

narrative.overview: Argus is a precision instrument, not a dashboard and not a journal: a calm dark index the owner opens for a few minutes, uses without friction, and closes. The ground is a lifted cool slate and every container is an opaque plate, separated by fill steps and 1px lines rather than translucency, glow or texture. Against that quiet ground there is exactly one signal, a yellow that means "do this" or "you are here"; colour is otherwise spent on meaning, with four solid Morse mode colours, three track colours, and permanent learned progress. A native sans carries everything a person reads and operates; a native mono carries everything the instrument reports. Brushed Gunmetal is retired; light mode is parked as an idea (#237).
keyCharacteristics: A lifted slate chassis and opaque plates; hierarchy from fill steps, size and weight, never from translucency, glow or texture
One signal-yellow action: the primary action, the current selection, the current step and the done part of a path
Four solid mode colours and three track colours used for wayfinding, with learned progress permanent
Sans for language, mono for readings, and the boundary between them is meaningful
Dense index rows over card grids; a topic list reads like a table of contents
Few, large words: a tile or label is one or two words, and a screen shows what the task will put in front of you
Motion is state feedback, one piece of card physics, and a short arrival for the Library list and its gauges; nothing moves for its own sake

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Signal yellow appears only on the primary action, the current selection, the current step and the done part of a path. It is never decoration. Two primary actions on one screen means one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Permanent Learning Rule
rules.body: Learned means learned. A later optional Test retains its score without decay, repair routing, progress loss or required extra learning. The legacy copper token is unused by current learning states.

rules.name: The Solid Plates Rule
rules.body: Every container is opaque. No translucent fills, no translucent borders, no glow, and no gradient standing in for a colour. Neutral drop shadows are allowed for things that lift (the card, a sheet) and for the pressed state.

rules.name: Mode Colours Show Where You Are
rules.body: A Morse mode hue appears only on its own tile, its session frame and its pips. Tracks and modes never share a screen. Track colours may fill icons, gauges and rings, never a side stripe.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Page and section headings do not get an eyebrow label above them. Eyebrow-weight type is reserved for genuine metadata, never as heading decoration.

rules.name: The One Lifted Surface Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from fill steps and 1px lines; recessed fields read by a darker fill. A deep neutral shadow is spent once, on the single most important surface per view.

rules.name: The Nothing-Nests Rule
rules.body: A card does not contain another card. If a component needs internal grouping, use a hairline divider or spacing, not a nested bordered container.

rules.name: The No-Fold Rule
rules.body: Content is either visible or it lives on its own page; nothing is folded.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Mono means a reading; sans means language. A button verb never uses the mono, and a status word never uses the sans. Mixing them destroys the only signal that tells the eye which is which.

dos: Do open every top-level view on the task (what's next, start Test), never on a summary, pitch, or hero.
Do hold Signal yellow to its roles: primary action, current selection, current step and the done part of a path.
Do build hierarchy from fill steps and 1px lines, and reserve the deep shadow for the one lifted surface per view.
Do show the stimulus on a mode tile: a letter, a waveform, dits and dashes, or your own text at a cursor.
Do render topic listings as a dense hairline-divided index, not a card grid.
Do give every interactive element default, hover, focus-visible, active, and disabled states, with a minimum 44px primary touch target.
Do name controls as direct actions and explain the recovery path in empty states.
Do keep completed topics learned permanently.
Do keep JSON export/import visually first-class, not buried as a settings afterthought.
Do continue the top unfinished topic from Home; show Add something to learn when none is active.
Do set every reading (count, date, position, status, track) in the mono voice, and everything a person reads or presses in the sans.
donts: Don't put a hero, oversized slogan, or eyebrow label above a page or section heading.
Don't build a wall of identical metric cards; consolidate into one instrument-panel stat strip.
Don't nest a card inside a card, or use border-left/border-right as a coloured accent stripe on any row, alert, or callout.
Don't use translucent fills or borders for colour; every container is a solid plate.
Don't add subtitles to tiles. A tile is one word and the stimulus it shows.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, or decorative rings/gradients anywhere in the Test loop.

Don't let the material drag the language tactical. The chassis is slate; the words are plain. Argus says 'Learned' and 'Start', never 'TST' or 'INITIATE EXECUTION'. The subject matter invites the opposite, and the framing is competence, not catastrophe.
Don't add streaks, badges, XP, or any shame-based nudge for missed Test days. The Morse path is a progress visualisation, not gamification.
Don't widen the mobile layout for desktop and call it done; desktop gets a genuine side-rail, task-oriented layout.
Don't use a serif or fluid display typeface; display character comes from size, weight and tracking.
Don't add outer glow. A plate is lit by the room, not by itself, and glow smears on OLED.
